title: Single urgency per ChatPushConfig is too coarse
description: One urgency value covers all messages matched by a config. Cannot express 'high urgency for DMs and mentions, normal for channel traffic' without creating one ChatPushConfig entry per chatId, which does not scale. Consider adding a mentionUrgency field to ChatPushConfig that overrides urgency when hasMention is true, and possibly a directUrgency for kind=direct.
